title: It leaks!
text:
It leaks!. I paid almost $140 for this blanket in January 2019 (I see it's cheaper now) and it's now in the garbage. The problem is that the fabric that holds the tiny, sand-like glass beads is very thin and flimsy, as are the stitches holding the pockets together.
Since it's a heavy blanket, I often had to tug to get it in place, and the fabric or stitches would rip. My husband said it was like we lived at the beach and went to bed with sandy feet every night. I'll probably be finding those tiny beads around for years to come.
I loved having the weighted blanket and I miss it - however, if I buy another, it won't have beads.
